title: The Secondary school of the town
subtitle: 校园生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：校园生活（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：secondary　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 secondary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the director wrote of ① a secondary school of the town in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② so secondary that nobody in the theatre would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the secondary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the secondary school of the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1974 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too secondary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the secondary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a secondary matter of the plan, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as secondary as the matter of the plan they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was secondary or not, and he said so.

By 1987 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something secondary, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite secondary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the secondary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1990, at once, she wrote of another secondary school of the town in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less secondary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The secondary matter of the plan that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1992, was the one she could never quite name; the secondary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 中等（前置定语 a secondary school of the town：1980 年导演在戏报里记下的那件中等的中学）
B. adj. 中等／次要（两处加强说法：so secondary that … 与 no less secondary than …）
C. adj. 中等／次要（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 中等（表语 too secondary to do：母亲觉得它太中等，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 次要（前置定语 a secondary matter of the plan：叔叔把整件事称作一桩次要的问题）
F. adj. 次要（同级比较 as secondary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩方案中的次要问题相比）
G. adj. 次要（后置定语 something secondary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 次要（受程度副词修饰 quite secondary：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a secondary school of the town
the secondary school of the town that
a secondary matter of the plan
The secondary matter of the plan that

answers.why: secondary 意为“中等”，1980 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件中等的中学”，此处作前置定语 a secondary school of the town。
secondary 意为“中等”，此处用 so secondary that 结构，说它中等到戏院里没人敢靠近。
secondary 意为“中等”，戏报上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的中等镇上的中学，等于最高级的说法。
secondary 意为“中等”，母亲认为这件东西“太中等了，谁也用不上”，too secondary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
secondary 意为“次要”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩次要的问题”，此处作前置定语 a secondary matter of the plan。
secondary 意为“次要”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩方案中的次要问题一样次要”，同级比较用 as secondary as。
secondary 意为“次要”，戏报上那半行字要的是“次要的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something secondary。
secondary 意为“次要”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当次要”，quite 修饰原级 secondary。
secondary 意为“次要”，no less secondary than 表示“其次要不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之次要不亚于任何人的预料。
secondary 意为“次要”，母亲 1992 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的次要问题”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1980 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件中等的中学。（a secondary school of the town）
它中等到戏院里没有一个人敢靠近。（so secondary that …）
母亲觉得它太中等，谁也用不上。（too secondary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩次要的问题。（a secondary matter of the plan）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩方案中的次要问题一样次要。（as secondary as …）
到了 1987 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件次要的东西。（something secondary）
answers: In 1980 the director wrote of a secondary school of the town in the poster.
It was so secondary that nobody in the theatre would go near it.
My mother thought it too secondary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a secondary matter of the plan.
He said nobody would call it as secondary as the matter of the plan they had once had.
By 1987 the poster asked for nothing but something secondary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 secondary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1980 the director wrote of a secondary school of the town in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the secondary school of the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too secondary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a secondary matter of the plan, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite secondary, and everybody laughed.
The secondary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
